CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeTool.description: Cubeless native editor diagnostics, asset verification and compiler operations. Never reference this editor class from game assets.

tools.description:
Read imported skeletal mesh sections for one LOD, including enabled state and source section identity.
SkeletalMeshPath is an object path such as /Game/Meshes/SK_Test.SK_Test; LODIndex is zero-based.
Returns JSON matching the legacy GetSections data fields plus operation status. Loads the mesh but never edits or saves it.
If mesh compilation is pending, returns a retryable read error instead of forcing synchronous compilation.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.GetSkeletalMeshSections

tools.description: Return JSON with engine/project identity, dirty packages, PIE state and MCP plugin state. Does not save, compile, close, or modify assets.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.GetEditorDiagnostics

tools.description:
Compile a Blueprint and return JSON with actual compiler errors, warnings and tokenized messages.
BlueprintPath is the asset object path. Optional node refresh occurs before compilation; optional save occurs only after compilation passes.
This mutates compiler/generated-class state, is not atomic, and never retries or rolls back. Rejects PIE/SIE.
A successful compile is not proof of runtime behavior or a reload; see saved and validation_scope separately.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.CompileBlueprintValidation

tools.description:
Audit saved package dependencies for Cubeless, legacy MCP, official MCP, Toolset Registry, Python and EditorScriptingUtilities references.
PackageNames are long package names such as /Game/Tests/BP_Test, without object suffixes.
Includes hard and soft package references. Optional recursion has a strict MaxPackages budget (1..4096).
Returns JSON containing edges, violations, incomplete reasons and dirty packages. Incomplete scans never pass.
Saved Asset Registry data only: not proof of unsaved object references, all possible editor-only classes, or plugin-free packaging.
tools.name: CubelessMCPUE58Editor.CubelessNativeToolset.AuditPackageDependencies

cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.batch_too.name: cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.batch_toolset.CubelessBatchTools
cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.batch_too.description: Ordered Blueprint/graph actions sharing one durable journal, without automatic rollback/retry.

tools.description:
Execute 1..100 explicitly supported Blueprint/graph actions in order on the game thread.

        Args:
            commands_json: JSON array of {"type":"CubelessBlueprintTools.create_blueprint","params":{"name":"BP_Name","parent_class":"Actor","package_path":"/Game/Blueprints"}} entries. Allowed BlueprintTools functions: create_blueprint, inspect_blueprint, compile_blueprint, compile_and_save_blueprint, compile_and_validate_blueprint. Allowed CubelessBlueprintGraphTools functions: inspect_graph, add_branch_node, set_node_position, delete_node, connect_graph_pins. Use each individual tool's exact parameters/defaults except operation_id, which belongs only to the whole batch. Up to 1 MiB input. No legacy aliases, result references, arbitrary tools or nested batches. All command names/types are checked before any action. Existing graph tool restrictions still apply.
            stop_on_error: Defaults True. False continues only known failures; uncertain mutation, journal failure, PIE/session guard, or the 15-second between-step budget always stops. One engine call cannot be preempted.
            operation_id: Durable whole-batch ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized inputs replay the recorded response without rerunning. Interrupted IDs never resume automatically.

        Returns:
            data_json.batch contains ordered child results, attempted/observed changes, partial results, skipped steps, per-step compile/save, forced-stop reason and timing. Compilation/saving occur only in explicitly requested actions. One transaction scope does not promise atomic rollback, disk recovery or all-action Undo support. Completed reads replay historical results for the same ID. Long asynchronous work and full legacy command coverage are not implemented.
tools.name: cubeless_mcp_ue58.registration.batch_toolset.CubelessBatchTools.execute_batch
